notes.title: Upcoming Gameplay News...
notes.notes:
Hello folks,
After the CO-OP gameplay becomes stable, I am planning a new development :)
My main tower defense goal is; diverging strategy and different gameplay combinations.
So I am planning to add a "HERO" system; all allies have unique Hero towers and these towers will have a passive spell. Also;some other Hero towers will be unlocked with in-game achievements or progressions.
This means there will be no more new allies to be added into the system for a while:)
Planning to add limited heroes first for watching gameplays and bug fixes in the 2024 Q4.
If you have any suggestions or feedback about anything, please let me know...
Have fun all.
